notes: A ruined great hall about 20.9 x 7.3 m with battered stone walls 4.3 m high to a corbelled cornice. It has a 7.4 m tower on the back-right corner (+x, -z) and a collapsed front-left corner that opens into a pilastered, beamed chamber with a carved hand on its back wall. The 1 m scale bar is about 43 px on the front view; the back view is drawn smaller. The top-right SIDE shows the tower on its left, which only fits the -x end. The second 'SIDE' (middle right: a long low wall with no tower and a rubble ramp) matches no face of this building, so it is left out and the +x end gets a colour guess only.
